# Verdance Systems AI

> Verdance Systems AI builds an Operations Team for owner-led businesses in
> South Africa and the UK: every enquiry answered within 60 seconds, every follow-up done,
> and the team's hours back. Every step is tracked, and you see the progress. It starts with a free
> Operations Map.

Founded and run by Daniel Bouwer, South Africa.
Website: https://verdancesystemsai.com
Contact: daniel@verdancesystemsai.com · WhatsApp and phone (South Africa): +27 73 996 1535 · Phone (UK): +44 7432 351517

## The facts

- Company: Verdance Systems AI, founded by Daniel Bouwer, based in South Africa.
- What it builds: an Operations Team. Every enquiry on WhatsApp, phone, website,
  email and social answered within 60 seconds, day or night. Every quote and
  enquiry followed up until the customer replies. A person takes over the
  moment it matters.
- Build: each build is different. Every stage is tracked, and the owner can see where it is at any time.
- How it starts: a free 30-minute Operations Map. It shows where time and
  money leak in enquiries, follow-up and admin, in hours and money, and what to
  fix first. The client keeps it whether or not they go ahead.
- When we propose: only if the client's own numbers show at least twice the
  monthly cost back.
- Who it is for: owner-led businesses in South Africa and the UK where people
  spend the day answering customers, chasing sales and doing admin.
- POPIA: consent records, opt-outs and an operator agreement are built in.
- Prices: not published. Every quote is in writing, after the Operations Map.

## Free tool

Missed call calculator: https://verdancesystemsai.com/missed-call-calculator
Works out what unanswered calls and messages cost a business per year from
three of its own numbers: contacts missed per week, average customer value and
close rate (missed per week x customer value x close rate x 52). No sign-up.
